text: The Border Princes may not have the resources or the manpower of the Empire, and yet the heirs of the colonist endure the daily struggle offered by irreducible neighbours.

Estalia is a nation projected outwards, like the peninsula that hosts it. Beyond an immense ocean lies Lustria and its well-defended riches. Eastwards, the Bretonnians and yes, the Tileans. Perhaps it is time for the might of Estalia to raise its head.

Tilea sits between its rival, Estalia, the Dwarfs of the Vaults, the troubled Border Princes and a lunatic sea infested by pirates, undead, corsairs and even orcish pirates. The Princes of Tilea are however sitting on a pile of wealth, efficient warriors and inventive minds...

The so-called Southern Realms stretch from the messy Border Princes to Estalia, and into their sparse colonies in the New World. These human realms may not be as powerful, or remotely as united as the Empire, but some of their parts are uniquely wealthy and dynamic. Alternatively, they are also substantially corrupt and pathologically quarrelsome. \\n\\nWhile the Border Princes are the refuge of any misfit living there for their sins, or leaving other regions in desperation, the City-States of Tilea are particularly famous for their wealth and for some of the best and most professional human warriors to ever grace the mercenary markets of the Old World. This is related to the presence of the Myrmidian cults, the strongest faith in the south, one that favours equally mercy, wisdom and tactical acumen.

Southern Realms

The Southern Realms offer the rosters of Tilea, Estalia, Border Princes and New World Colonies, each with their own peculiarities. \\nAs a whole, the Southern Realms offer good infantry and cavalry, some being the best the human race has to offer, including a large pool of Regiments of Renown. However, they lack in monsters and expensive machinery compared to other races, and rely on combined arms to neutralize the biggest threats.

Although the dwellers of the Borderlands wouldn't care to admit it, the humans of this country are like a large, robust creeper. Centuries ago, human colonists and refugees started to built a new nation on the borders of the Old World. Anyone else would have been strangled between mountains and sea, between Dwarfs and Greenskins. Today, one of the many self-defined princes of these lands may have the potential to unite the many squabbling towns and clear out the many threats. Valmir Gausser distinguished himself as a solid warrior and commander in Araby, and can claim to have friends in both Bretonnia and Dwarfdom.

While many of his descriptions include the words "gold-obsessed" and "deranged", Lupio Sunscryer also has the ambition necessary to fulfill Estalia's destiny. As he readies his people for war, Lupio looks to the north and to the east; should his tercios encroach on Bretonnia or Tilea first? Closer to home, ratmen infest the fallen city of Tylos and the peninsula is ever threatened by unholy pirates and beasts of Chaos. It is by Myrmidia's will that Lupio will purge these abominations and cement Estalia as the foremost nation of men in the Old World.

The news about Borgio's death to a poisoned fork was greatly exaggerated. To the relief of his many followers, troops and allies, the Prince of Miragliano is back in business and ready to lead his hosts against the mounting threats to Tilea.

The city-state of Pavona has been mostly destroyed. Not by other Tileans as so many times it has been threatened, but by the greenskin beasts from the mountains. Lucrezzia is not only the most beautiful woman in the Old World, or so they say, but also a resourceful woman. If the old ally, Prince Borgio, cannot help her in vengeance, she can surely manipulate her way into Estalia for a new secure base.

Tilean is famous for many things, such as arts, mercenaries, cuisine and wealth. Leonardo Catrazza, away from the cumbersome presence of Borgio in Miragliano, has been investing in the silk road to export anything the Cathayans may be interested in, and ship back to Tilea anything that will sell dearly. New opportunities arise in Cathay, as the draconic rulers struggle for control, and Leonardo may very well profit from his partnership with the Iron Dragon in ways that neither of the two could foresee.

Some people are positively restless. Marco Colombo, famous explorer, commander and thus politician from a Tilean point of view is back on the move. Even after becoming Prince of Trantio as a follow-up, and uniquely succeeding in securing the friendship of Lord Mazdamundi (or at least, non-hostility). Colombo is overseas again, bringing his experience and wealth to bear on the frontier, paid exorbitantly by the Slann to destroy as many corsairs and pirates as possible.

The legend of El Cadavo originates in Tilea, land of a thousand mercenary commanders. Cadavo was one of the most ruthless, and he was ultimately responsible for the origins of another story, that of the Alcatani Fellowship. Years later, Cadavo is still a leader of men, stubborn entrepreneur, founder of colonies, peerless warrior. Some say all those stories cannot possibly fit one lifetime...

Heir to the Strigoi King Vorag Bloodytooth, Gashnag rules a small domain in the Border Princes. As opposed to his sire's aggressive and bloody tendencies, Gashnag has chosen a more peaceful and reclusive form of government, emulous to the empire of Ushoran, the very first of the Strigoi bloodline. The Black Prince, as he is rather affectionately known among his subjects, hides his true nature and personally protects the towns under his rule from incursions. In order to avoid unwanted attentions from feral Strigoi, jealous Von Carsteins or neighbouring Princes, Gashnag wears a heavy black cloak and multiple illusions, upholding a façade as a scarred but romantically heroic figure of selflessness.\\nGashnag is inclined to find and research Ushoran's secrets, lost in the Badlands, to augment his powers. However, he needs to decide whether to continue on that route or rush back to protect his princedom from encroaching Ogres.
Tilean Sorceress Lucrezzia Belladonna secured Bilbali as her new seat, and her arts of manipulation will serve her well in Estalia and beyond.\\n{{tr:frontend_bullet_estalia}}

\\nLuccini is a city of eccentricity, opulence, and military traditions. All in the athletic grip of its current prince.\\n{{tr:frontend_bullet_tilea}}

Luccini is one of the most ancient human settlements in the Old World, and Lorenzo Lupo is, appropriately, a leader that seems born in ages past. Like many of his ancient bloodline, he is considered a bizarre and not completely sane individual; unlike many of his family, he carries his athletic body and the archaic weaponry of his forebears with extreme efficiency. And he must, for Luccini is again threatened by pirates, greenskins and ratmen.

Lucrezzia Belladonna is the most beautiful lady in the Old World, at least according to those who aren't interested in getting on the bad side of devious plots and mysterious assassinations. From her current seat in florid Pavona, Lucrezzia survives seven influential but ultimately-disposable husbands and rules over a spidersilk net of subtle political dominance. However, one mistake, and many enemies might flock against her.
